💼 Sales

How to onboard a new dealer?

if you have onboarded a new dealer probably the client is already saved in our system with all the important information (VAT, pricelist, payment terms, etc) In this case move directly to Chapter 2.

Otherwise follow Chapter 1 for client creation.

Chapter 1 — Create the dealer in Odoo Contacts

Go to contact App > Click NEW

⚠️ Required client fields — fill in from the start
  • Individual or company (select correctly)
  • Address
  • Zip code
  • City
  • Country
  • VAT Number — mandatory from day one
  • Phone number
  • E-mail
  • Language
Missing fields will cause problems downstream.
Note: if you do not fill in all those info you will create problems afterwards.
1
Click on Sales & Purchase and add the payment items – in red in the pic below.

Set payment terms: 30 Days

Note: you can also setup the fiscal position, this will help ensure the taxes are always correct:

For BE client setup = Regime National

For all other clients = Regime Intracommunataire

Select the correct pricelist you want to assign to this client. There are several pricelist per different countries (ALLY, PRO, ELITE for each country – make sure to select the level of your country)

Click Save & Close.

Chapter 2 — Grant B2B portal access & complete onboarding

2
Use the search bar to look for your client:

The icon of the building means the contact has been saved as a “company” and not an individual. Hence, the contact information are the contact of their headquarter.

If several contacts have been saved within the headquarter profile you should see several different icons like in the pic below. If you need to add several address for one contact click “ADD” inside the contact card and create the different contacts for invoicing, deliveries, etc.

Meaning of the icons:

3
Building > headquarter contact and address
4
Person profile > Person contact and address
5
1 Dollar icon > accounting profile – where the invoices will be sent
6
Little van > where goods will be delivered. Note: if more than one icon with little van it means that there are several delivery addressed associated to that profile.
7
Open now the Headquarter icon or the icon of the person you want to give access to odoo.
8
Click now on the little wheel close to the name:
9
Click on Grant Portal access > then gran access to the e-mail you want to grant B2B portal access

Now your client will receive an e-mail from Ahooga.odoo.com saying to setup their password. From now on your client has access to Odoo portal. Be careful to have really setup the client information before giving them access otherwise they will see wrong prices in the portal and they will complain!!!!

10
Now move the lead in the correct CRM stage, by dragging and moving their card in the CRM to “signed deal”. You can do this directly from the Contact application you are in:
11
Now you need to make sure the dealer will be installed in our website!!

Fill in this document at this link:

Retailer Follow Up file

Fill in a new line with the information required for the shop:

Name, Language, Address, Opening hours, which bikes they have A/E

12
Communicate to it@ahooga.odoo.com and it@ahooga.bike and to alix@ahooga.bike that you have filled in a new shop information in the Retailer Follow up file. This is necessary for making sure they will be in our website, active as a test ride location and also active as pick up point for online sales.
13
Now you have to inform the dealer per mail on the functionalities of our B2B portal. Here below the 2 template e-mails for English or German. Consult Appendix B to check the e-mail to send.
14
Propose to the dealer some marketing material as part of the deal. Consult with the client the marketing catalogue and make a sales odoo order.

Catalogue link: MARKETING CATALOG.

15
Fix with the client one meeting where you are going to train them on the bike. The client should be confident on making the sales order alone on B2B portal, repair the bike, know which parts to order.
16
Fill in the New Client Sheet online, export it as PDF, sign it and send it to massimiliano@ahooga.bike.
📧 Appendix B — B2B Portal introduction email (German)

German version for DE dealers — send as-is, substituting dealer name.

📧 Appendix — B2B Portal introduction email (English)

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am reaching out to introduce our B2B portal. The portal is designed to support you in the following areas:

  • Purchasing new bikes
  • Submitting warranty claims
  • Accessing the knowledge base

Below is a step-by-step overview:

1) Purchasing new bikes

To place an order, simply add the desired products to your cart, proceed to checkout, and select “bank transfer” as the payment method.

No immediate payment is required. Our standard payment terms of 30 days apply. However, selecting a payment method is necessary in the system to complete the order process.

2) Submitting warranty claims

In case of quality issues, please follow the steps below:

Set up your password for the B2B portal by clicking the link in the email sent to your address

Go to: https://ahooga.odoo.com

Log in

Click on “Warranty Form”

Fill in the required information

Please note:

The bike ID can be found on the label located on the seat tube

The more pictures you provide, the faster we can process and resolve the issue

3) Access to the portal content

Through the B2B portal, you also have access to:

The e-commerce shop

The knowledge library

In the “MAX” folder, you will find three subfolders:

A. MAX Assistance

Part numbers

Repair instruction videos

Repair and assembly manuals

Rear rack assembly instructions

Bafang World (for older models)

Mivice World (for newer models)

B. MAX Sales All materials to help you and your team better understand and communicate our key product advantages.

C. Media Library All assets you may need to update your website or social media channels

4) Orders and deliveries

You can track the status of your orders under “My Account” on https://ahooga.odoo.com.

By clicking on your orders, you will be able to see the planned delivery date for each shipment.

Next steps / Support

If you have any questions or would like a short walkthrough of the portal, feel free to reach out. We can also schedule a quick call to ensure your team is fully onboarded and operational.

We look forward to building a successful collaboration together.
